_note: A quantifier is a claim about a SET, so the set is named and counted here the same way every numeral names its computation. Both of this deck's universals point at objects the FRAME draws rather than at a population in the world, which is the honest case for this technique: a reader can count what the sentence is about without leaving the slide.
